snippet.title: A Fly in the Array, Gameplay
snippet.description:
Companion to the group art exhibition, AFlyintheArray.com , launched  for the Wrong Biennale 2025 the.wrong . 

https://zegeer.itch.io/aflyinthearray

A game I made this Summer while curating A Fly in the Array​ exhibition for the Wrong Biennial, made from assets borrowed from the virtual exhibition website. Also a domestic tableaux, photos of our rug, the building lobby floor tiles, an orchid given as a gift to my daughter from a former student. Teaching myself Unity to teach to students and teaching myself creative cannibalism, folding a curatorial project into a class, dodging between the guardians that divide the discourses as institutions crumble to epochal cultural shifts, coming up for air in 2026 confused, refreshed, angry and resolute. (WASD Space) 

#Aflyinthearray #gamedesign #unity #stilllife #wrongbiennial #animation
